reverse_finding: VIN pin supplied by behavioral current source G_ABMII1; VIN_ORG is an ideal sensed voltage, no physical VOUT-to-VIN body diode. Forced OUT3.3/IN0 reports only +1.5uA source delivery.
reject: Do not interpret collapse hold-up or absent negative input current as actual reverse blocking.
source_current_warning: I(V_SRC) includes the ideal 1uF input capacitor current; negative edge spikes are not isolated LDO reverse current.
excluded: AA or mux or NRST or SD writing
